title: daemon.channel_listener.ChannelEvent
description: One frame on the `GET /channels` SSE stream — the offer lifecycle.

anyOf.title: Offer
anyOf.description: A channel offer — live broadcast or connect-time replay.

anyOf.title: OfferWithdrawn
anyOf.description:
The offer is no longer available (accepted elsewhere, or the
publisher abandoned it). Sent only to connections that saw it.

anyOf.title: Live
anyOf.description:
The connect-time replay is complete — this connection is caught
up. Sent exactly once per connection, right after the replay.
